lines: I breathed in the sigh I softly let out.
Regret leaves a bitter aftertaste.
Always—why? I remain unable to say the crucial thing.
The next sunrise is showing its face.
I slice the fate I grew to hate with a knife.
If I could start over once more,
I might never meet you.
It begins at the moment my voice resonated.
Life’s limit—my heart is counting.
Even if I grant it, even if I grant it,
the wish that never ends.
Sweat-soaked, I ran; the world’s second hand
will someday leave the stopped me behind.
How many more times can I laugh with you?
I’m testing myself.
Catch the Moment
Each time I count one happiness,
I get scared of the changing future, but
let’s cherish and nurture the seed of love.
Even thick clouds will eventually
break through, I wonder.
Your voice echoed, passing through my whole body,
knocking on the door of my heart.
Even if I’m cowardly, I’ll open it.
Because I want to believe.
At the foot I thought was empty,
someday will grow deep, certain roots.
Even if a stormy night comes,
I won’t waver, no matter how many times.
Catching up or overtaking,
you suddenly become incomprehensible,
just when our breathing times match,
it makes me happy.
